rows.note: Use this for military or large-scale, long-range matters contrasted with tactical ones.

example.english: This deployment is very important to this strategic operation.
example.traditional: 呢項部署對今次戰略性行動十分重要。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 bou6 syu3 deoi3 gam1 ci3 zin3 loek6 sing3 hang4 dung6 sap6 fan1 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose formal adjective for something relating to strategy in general.

example.english: The company needs to make a strategic investment.
example.traditional: 公司要作出策略性投資。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jiu3 zok3 ceot1 caak3 loek6 sing3 tau4 zi1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when describing an approach or action as deliberately planned and strategically thought out.

example.english: The way you arranged this was really strategic.
example.traditional: 你咁樣安排真係好有策略嘅。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng6 on1 paai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 caak3 loek6 ge3
